sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:26

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:26:1
items.html: His HGT were included and clothed in his HBD, etc., and all the nine Sefirot of AA were included together: As above, for now he must receive from the HGT of Atik, which stand in the place of the HGT of Nekudim. Therefore AA must raise the ZON, which stand in his NHY, to his GAR, which clothe upon the HGT of Atik. Therefore all the nine Sefirot of AA must be included one in another, and they are nine months. And then ZON arrive at the first Ibur of the internality, to receive from the HGT of Atik, as explained.
